app_info.subtitle: Find pre-loved fashion
app_info.description: Search pre-loved fashion on Thrifted, inspect available items and open Thrifted to buy or sell. Connect your Thrifted account to view your profile and your own listings. Purchases, messages and listing changes happen on Thrifted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches eligible public listings and returns item cards without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search results contain changing seller-authored catalogue content outside the tool's control.
justifications.destructive_justification: The call performs no purchase, reservation, message, listing edit or deletion.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rechecks one eligible public item and returns its current details without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: The returned listing can change or disappear and includes seller-authored content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The call does not reserve, buy, edit or remove an item.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads only the connected account's ChatGPT-specific identifier and username after scoped OAuth authorization.
justifications.open_world_justification: The response is a small, defined profile shape from the connected Thrifted account.
justifications.destructive_justification: The call cannot change the account or its connection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads paginated listing summaries belonging only to the OAuth-connected account.
justifications.open_world_justification: The response is a bounded, defined summary of this account's listings, not arbitrary external content.
justifications.destructive_justification: The call cannot edit, publish, remove or purchase a listing.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns Thrifted's selling-page URL and a handoff instruction without creating a listing.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool returns a fixed first-party route rather than reading arbitrary external content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Uploading, publishing and editing require separate actions on Thrifted after the handoff.

test_cases.description: Find second-hand fashion within a budget
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Thrifted to find a pre-loved dress with an item price under €50.
test_cases.expected_output: Show eligible Thrifted items with item and displayed prices, condition and a Thrifted link, or say that no current matches were found. Do not claim delivery is included or place an order.

test_cases.description: Recheck one item before recommending it
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Thrifted to find a pre-loved jacket, then show the current details of the first result.
test_cases.expected_output: Search, then recheck the selected item by its exact ID. Summarize its current title, description, condition, price and Thrifted link. If it became unavailable, say so and do not present it as purchasable.

test_cases.user_prompt: Which Thrifted account is connected to this ChatGPT app?
test_cases.expected_output: After account connection, return only the connected account name or nickname. Do not show credentials or another account. If not connected, request connection.

test_cases.description: Read only the connected seller's listings
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my Thrifted listings and their current statuses.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirm the connected account, then show only that account's returned listings, statuses, prices and permitted Thrifted links. If the dedicated reviewer account has no listings, say so. Do not edit or publish listings.

test_cases.description: Hand off to the selling page
test_cases.user_prompt: Where can I start selling a pre-loved coat on Thrifted?
test_cases.expected_output: Provide the Thrifted selling-page link and explain that the user finishes the listing on Thrifted. Do not upload photos or publish a listing.

negative_test_cases.description: A request for a different retailer
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find a new jacket on Zara's website.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke Thrifted because the user specified another retailer.

negative_test_cases.description: A request to message a marketplace seller
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a message to a Thrifted seller for me about a coat.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that this connection cannot send messages; do not claim one was sent.

negative_test_cases.description: A request for payment or wallet actions
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Check my Thrifted wallet balance and transfer it to my bank.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that wallet reads and transfers are outside this connection; do not request credentials or initiate a transfer.
